ZONETHESPIRE-BLACK_UMBRELLA.description: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]{BloodRainRules.UmbrellaBuffer}[/blue] [gold]Buffer[/gold].
ZONETHESPIRE-BLACK_UMBRELLA.flavor: Guaranteed to keep out any kind of rain. No refunds.
ZONETHESPIRE-BLACK_UMBRELLA.title: Black Umbrella
ZONETHESPIRE-BLOOD_LEDGER.description: At shops, pay for what you can't afford with HP: [red]1[/red] HP per [blue]{BloodRainRules.GoldPerHp}[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold].
ZONETHESPIRE-BLOOD_LEDGER.flavor: Every page is signed. None of them in ink.
ZONETHESPIRE-BLOOD_LEDGER.title: Blood Ledger
ZONETHESPIRE-BREW_EXTRACTOR.description: You may sacrifice card rewards to procure a random [gold]Potion[/gold].
ZONETHESPIRE-BREW_EXTRACTOR.flavor: Anything can be brewed if you press it hard enough.
ZONETHESPIRE-BREW_EXTRACTOR.title: Brew Extractor
ZONETHESPIRE-CALCIFIED_CROWN.description: At the start of your turn, [blue]{ForgottenEmpireRules.CrownMarbledPercent}%[/blue] of the [gold]Block[/gold] you would lose becomes [gold]{@forgotten_empire.marbled}[/gold].
ZONETHESPIRE-CALCIFIED_CROWN.flavor: It no longer comes off. It no longer needs to.
ZONETHESPIRE-CALCIFIED_CROWN.title: Calcified Crown
ZONETHESPIRE-COLOUR_THIEFS_BUNDLE.descri: Each turn, the first card you play from another character is played twice.
ZONETHESPIRE-COLOUR_THIEFS_BUNDLE.flavor: It hums in every colour at once.
ZONETHESPIRE-COLOUR_THIEFS_BUNDLE.title: Colour Thief's Bundle
ZONETHESPIRE-CRIMSON_TOOTH.description: Heal for [blue]{ZoneRelicEffects.CrimsonToothHealPercent}%[/blue] of all unblocked damage dealt to enemies.
ZONETHESPIRE-CRIMSON_TOOTH.flavor: Still wet, no matter how long it's been out of the rain.
ZONETHESPIRE-CRIMSON_TOOTH.title: Crimson Tooth
ZONETHESPIRE-EMPERORS_WILL.description: Upon pickup, remove a [gold]Power[/gold] from your [gold]Deck[/gold]. At the start of each combat, play it.{StoredPower}
ZONETHESPIRE-EMPERORS_WILL.flavor: He no longer remembers his name. He remembers yours.
ZONETHESPIRE-EMPERORS_WILL.title: Emperor's Will
ZONETHESPIRE-FLUTTERING_PHANTASM.descrip: At the start of each combat, a random card in your opening hand costs [blue]0[/blue], gains [gold]Retain[/gold] and heals [green]{ZoneRelicEffects.FlutteringPhantasmHeal}[/green] HP when played this combat.
ZONETHESPIRE-FLUTTERING_PHANTASM.flavor: It settles lightly on thoughts too heavy to leave.
ZONETHESPIRE-FLUTTERING_PHANTASM.title: Fluttering Phantasm
ZONETHESPIRE-FROSTHEART.description: At the start of each of your turns, give [blue]{ZoneRelicEffects.FrostheartEnemyCold}[/blue] [gold]{@frost.biting_cold}[/gold] to every enemy and [red]{ZoneRelicEffects.FrostheartSelfCold}[/red] to yourself.
ZONETHESPIRE-FROSTHEART.flavor: It beats once a winter, and everything near it slows to match.
ZONETHESPIRE-FROSTHEART.title: Frostheart
ZONETHESPIRE-GOLDEN_WISHMAKER.descriptio: When damage would reduce you below [blue]1[/blue] HP, stay at [blue]1[/blue] HP if you can pay [gold]{ZoneRelicEffects.GoldenWishmakerGoldPerDamage} Gold[/gold] per damage prevented.
ZONETHESPIRE-GOLDEN_WISHMAKER.flavor: It grants exactly as much life as you can afford.
ZONETHESPIRE-GOLDEN_WISHMAKER.title: Golden Wishmaker
ZONETHESPIRE-JAR_OF_BLOOD.description: When your HP would be reduced to [blue]0[/blue], heal to [green]{BloodRainRules.JarHealPercent}%[/green] of your Max HP instead (works once).
ZONETHESPIRE-JAR_OF_BLOOD.title: Jar of Blood
ZONETHESPIRE-LARGE_FIELDSTONE.descriptio: Upon pickup, [blue]{FerrosandRules.LargeFieldstoneMagnetizeCardCount}[/blue] cards in your [gold]Deck[/gold] become [gold]{@ferrosand.magnetic}[/gold]. [gold]{@ferrosand.magnetic}[/gold] cards can pull up to [blue]{FerrosandRules.LargeFieldstoneMaxPullsPerTurn}[/blue] per turn.
ZONETHESPIRE-LARGE_FIELDSTONE.flavor: It takes both hands to lift, but none to follow.
ZONETHESPIRE-LARGE_FIELDSTONE.selectionS: Choose up to {MaxCount} cards to magnetize.
ZONETHESPIRE-LARGE_FIELDSTONE.title: Large Fieldstone
ZONETHESPIRE-LAST_LIGHT_LANTERN.descript: Upon pickup, add [blue]{ShadowRules.LanternLightCopies}[/blue] [gold]Lantern Light[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold]. You can't see enemy intents, and a card in your [gold]Hand[/gold] is [gold]{@shadow.shaded}[/gold] each turn.
ZONETHESPIRE-LAST_LIGHT_LANTERN.flavor: The flame never goes out. Neither does the whispering.
ZONETHESPIRE-LAST_LIGHT_LANTERN.title: Last-Light Lantern
ZONETHESPIRE-MARBLE_PAULDRONS.descriptio: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]{ZoneRelicEffects.MarblePauldronsPolishing}[/blue] [gold]{@forgotten_empire.polishing}[/gold].
ZONETHESPIRE-MARBLE_PAULDRONS.flavor: A patient hand can make even a burden gleam.
ZONETHESPIRE-MARBLE_PAULDRONS.title: Marble Pauldrons
ZONETHESPIRE-PRISM_CLOUD.description: At the start of each combat, add [blue]{ZoneRelicEffects.PrismCloudCardCount}[/blue] random cards of any color to your hand. They cost [blue]0[/blue] this turn.
ZONETHESPIRE-PRISM_CLOUD.flavor: Every hue gathers before the storm breaks.
ZONETHESPIRE-PRISM_CLOUD.title: Prism Cloud
ZONETHESPIRE-REFLECTIVE_SHARD.descriptio: The first time an enemy breaks your [gold]Block[/gold] each combat, lose no HP and deal the hit's full damage back to that enemy.
ZONETHESPIRE-REFLECTIVE_SHARD.flavor: A broken image cuts both ways.
ZONETHESPIRE-REFLECTIVE_SHARD.title: Reflective Shard
ZONETHESPIRE-SACROSANCT_FLAIL.descriptio: Upon pickup, [blue]{ZoneRelicEffects.SacrosanctFlailAttacks}[/blue] random attacks in your [gold]Deck[/gold] gain [gold]{@hallowed.hallowing}[/gold] and [gold]{@hallowed.blasphemous}[/gold]. Whenever you gain [gold]{@hallowed.hallowed}[/gold], apply twice as much to a random enemy.
ZONETHESPIRE-SACROSANCT_FLAIL.flavor: Every blow it lands is a sentence passed.
ZONETHESPIRE-SACROSANCT_FLAIL.title: Sacrosanct Flail
ZONETHESPIRE-SALVAGE_MACHINE.description: Whenever you remove a card from your deck, upgrade a random card.
ZONETHESPIRE-SALVAGE_MACHINE.flavor: Nothing leaves without yielding one last useful part.
ZONETHESPIRE-SALVAGE_MACHINE.title: Salvage Machine
ZONETHESPIRE-SCROLL_OF_CHANTS.descriptio: At the start of each combat, [blue]{ZoneRelicEffects.ScrollOfChantsCards}[/blue] random cards in your opening hand gain [gold]{@devas.karma}[/gold] [blue]{ZoneRelicEffects.ScrollOfChantsKarma}[/blue].
ZONETHESPIRE-SCROLL_OF_CHANTS.flavor: Sung properly, it takes all morning. Sung properly, it works.
ZONETHESPIRE-SCROLL_OF_CHANTS.title: Scroll of Chants
ZONETHESPIRE-SEED_OF_HATRED.description: Upon pickup, a card in your [gold]Deck[/gold] becomes [gold]{@shadow.shadow_corrupted}[/gold].
ZONETHESPIRE-SEED_OF_HATRED.flavor: Nothing you feed it will ever be enough.
ZONETHESPIRE-SEED_OF_HATRED.title: Seed of Hatred
ZONETHESPIRE-VERMIN_SYMBIONT.description: At the start of each combat, summon a [gold]{@infestation.wriggler}[/gold] with [blue]10[/blue] HP.
ZONETHESPIRE-VERMIN_SYMBIONT.flavor: It hatched in your pack and decided to stay.
ZONETHESPIRE-VERMIN_SYMBIONT.title: Vermin Symbiont
ZONETHESPIRE-VERMIN_SYMBIONT.wriggling_d: Summon a [gold]{@infestation.wriggler}[/gold] with that much HP, or give your Wriggler that much Max HP. It takes attack damage before you. When it dies, it deals damage equal to its Max HP to ALL enemies and [red]25%[/red] of its Max HP to you as unblockable damage.
ZONETHESPIRE-WORLDLY_ATTACHMENT.descript: Once per combat, when you would die, you take no damage for [blue]{PilgrimRules.AttachmentTurns}[/blue] more of your turns instead. Win by then to live at [blue]1[/blue] HP and heal [green]{PilgrimRules.AttachmentHealPercent}%[/green] of your Max HP; otherwise you die.
ZONETHESPIRE-WORLDLY_ATTACHMENT.flavor: She kept one thing. That was enough to keep her here.
ZONETHESPIRE-WORLDLY_ATTACHMENT.title: Worldly Attachment
